notes.title: Patch 2025 February 26th
notes.content:
Modified Parry, you get 1 damage regardless of your armor and the attack when it's activated now
Bosses that aren't unlocked show up more frequently now
Fixed a bug that enemies with a Healer trait try to heal defeated enemies
Fixed a bug where number of Bound effect doesn't show up for enemies

notes.title: Patch 2025 February 21st
notes.content:
Added an easy mode. (It disables achievements) It will be available from the button in the corner that appears after getting gameover once after this update
Modified the trait of ghost so that it doesn't softlock the game. It expires in 10 turns

notes.title: Patch 2025 February 18th
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that RoundTwoReady detects if the value reached max in the entire turn, not with the action
Fixed a bug that if actions that are only usable once per combat gets essentialized after being used, it stays unusable
Rebalanced enemies health a little
Rebalanced Tackle, BulwarkStrike, Sublimation
Reroll count starts from 3 and it is saved between combats now, it get refilled after beating a boss (Start from 0 rerolls in a save file made before this update, sorry for the inconvenience)
